TunnelLock creates a separate “secure space” on your phone. Apps you put in it can only use the internet through the VPN. If the VPN drops even for a moment, Android itself cuts their internet; the app is not closed and works again once the connection is back.
1. Tap “Create secure space” and confirm Android\'s screens.
2. TunnelLock opens inside the secure space (with a briefcase badge).
3. Under Servers, add a V2Ray link or a subscription link.
4. Add apps to the secure space from this outer app (without the briefcase).
The secure space is being set up…

• Apps in the secure space can only reach the internet through this app's VPN.
• While the service runs, the tunnel is always up. If the server drops, packets are discarded inside the tunnel and nothing leaves through the normal network.
• If the connection drops while you use an app, the app stays open and only loses internet; it works again once the connection is back.
• If the app itself is closed or killed, Android's “Always-on VPN” + “Block connections without VPN” cuts the secure space off completely.
• When you disconnect yourself (and “Pause apps” is on), protected apps can't be opened until you connect again.
• Your normal apps (outside the secure space) are not affected.
